status: VOID -- NOT RUN. The data cannot support the experiment and that is the result.
why: The nlz benches record only each knockout's top ~250 genes, so 96.5% of every response matrix is exactly zero. A zero there means NOT RECORDED for that perturbation, not 'no response'. A contrast target Y[a,p,g]-Y[b,p,g] built by sampling (p,g) cells is therefore overwhelmingly censored-minus-censored, and training on it is the same error this project files elsewhere as treating a lookup that returned nothing as a measurement.
what_this_changes: The blocker is not the objective and not the number of cell lines. It is that the cross-cell contrast for a fixed perturbation is essentially unmeasured in these deposits: where two cells were both recorded for the same perturbation and gene, it is a median of 2 genes. No objective, gate, or context-conditioned attention fixes a target that does not exist.
data_requirement_restated: DENSE response matrices, not more cell lines. A deposit truncated to each knockout's top-N genes cannot support cross-cell contrasts at ANY number of cell lines because the recorded gene sets barely intersect. What is needed is the full measured gene set per perturbation for a modest number of shared perturbations across several lines.
route_that_would_unblock_it: The full matrices exist upstream: rpe1.h5ad, nadig_hepg2.h5ad and nadig_jurkat.h5ad are cell-level, and colab/reliable_edges.py already pseudobulks RPE1 to a dense 2,122 x 8,749 matrix. Rebuilding dense per-cell response matrices from those, instead of using the top-250 benches, is what makes the contrast tests runnable. That is a pipeline job, not a tweak.
